thread:
jamie: Quick sync — need to nail down routing policy precedence for free/pro/enterprise when primary model is saturated.

sara: tl;dr: free -> fallback to quantized small; pro -> prefer cheaper variant but keep latency SLO; enterprise -> always try reserved capacity & higher quality model, then fallback only if no reserved slots.

oliver: we also need to codify quota enforcement semantics. If user has burst credits but exceeds steady quota, should routing still prefer pro model? thinking about cost attribution.

danielle: +1 on burst credits. Proposal: policy fields 'soft_quota_threshold' and 'burst_window_seconds' plus 'prefer_reserved:true|false'.

kevin: can we see an example config? small one-line JSON would help.

jamie: sure — rough draft:
```
{
  "plan": "pro",
  "routing": [
    {"variant":"gpt-x-16k", "priority": 10, "conditions": {"quota_used_pct": "<90"}},
    {"variant":"gpt-x-8k-quant", "priority": 20, "conditions": {"quota_used_pct": ">=90", "burst_credits": ">0"}}
  ],
  "soft_quota_threshold": 0.9,
  "burst_window_seconds": 3600
}
```

sara: that looks readable. Question: should 'quota_used_pct' be evaluated against reserved quota or overall? we have tenants with dedicated capacity and global quotas.

oliver: important: evaluate in this order: reserved capacity -> plan steady quota -> burst. Otherwise we'd route enterprise to shared cheaper hw and blow up their SLA.

kevin: telemetry needs: metric names and tags so dashboard can show 'routing.decisions.variant' and 'routing.reason' with tags [plan, region, model_variant].

danielle: agreed. Also emit 'policy.match.path' with policy id to link back to config in console for audits.

ops-bot: simulator run complete: 2k requests across us-west/us-east. Results: pro plan fallback to quant variant at 91% quota used; enterprise retained reserved slot 99% of time. Link: https://ci.internal/sim/1778882222

sara: good. UX question: in console when editing policy, should we show live simulator results? would help non-technical PMs.

jamie: yes show quick sim with sample load and expected cost delta, plus 'undo' and 'canary rollout' toggle.

oliver: on API side, we must version these new policy fields. Suggest endpoint POST /v2/policies and keep v1 stable. v2 will include 'conditions' grammar.

danielle: grammar examples: 'quota_used_pct >= 0.9 AND region IN (eu-west,us-east)'. Keep it small to start.

kevin: telemetry small ask: add histogram 'policy.eval_latency_ms' to detect slow policy decision paths — rare but we saw 120ms spikes.

sara: final open item: enforcement mode when policy conflicts across plan/region overrides. We should define precedence order in docs: tenant_override > plan > region_default > global_default.

jamie: agreed. I'll write an RFC and attach a minimal policy schema + rollout plan. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

oliver: small follow-up: add tests for concurrency: simultaneous quota updates and routing decisions — flaky in sim today.

danielle: noted, I'll add e2e tests and a telemetry alert if mismatch rate > 0.5%.

kevin: filing dashboard ticket to add routing breakdown by variant and cost per 1k tokens.

jamie: OK closing thread, will post RFC link here when ready.

ops-bot: RFC created: https://go/repo/rfcs/1793
